description: Construction of the Double Circuit Transmission Line from the Mannar Grid Substation to Mullikulam Collector Grid Substation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-02-03, has granted approval to implement the formal procurement procedure to select a contractor for the construction of a 28 km long 220 kV double circuit transmission line from Mannar Grid Substation to Mullikulam Collector Grid Substation under Lot B of the Mullikulam Wind Power Transmission Project. Bids have been invited for this as per the International Competitive Bidding Procedure, and 05 bids have been submitted. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said contract to, JSL & Fentons Joint Venture - Intend (Jyoti Structure Limited, India and Hayleys Fentons Limited, Sri Lanka), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum equivalent to Sri Lankan Rupees 2,269.18 million (excluding taxes), based on the recommendation submitted by the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
